title: shared_equipment v1
description: Equipment that moves between hosts and rigs (equipment/shared.yml). Host configs reference an item by id (shared_id) instead of copying it; see docs/host_config_interface.md#shared-equipment. calibration, filterRef, event and date are copies of system_config v1's $defs (tests keep them equal).

id.description: Stable handle host configs use as shared_id. Never reused.

part_id.description: Optional link to hardware_library (<category>.<maker>.<model>). Omitted while unknown.

home_location.description: Where it lives when not in use.

current_location.description: Where it is now. A host config that references the item should be this host. With events, it must equal the derived location.

events.description: Optional append-only history of where the item was (docs/equipment_events.md). When present, current_location must equal the location the events derive.

location.description: A host id (hosts/<id>), a rig id, storage (optionally storage:<place>), or owner:<person or lab> when returned to its owner.

certificate_id.description: Certificate or report id; null for an in-house calibration without one.

due.description: Recalibration due date; a past date is reported as a warning.

filter.description: Photodetectors: the filter fitted when calibrated. A different fitted filter invalidates the calibration.

filterRef.description: A fitted filter, or the string none for an explicit bare detector.

part_id.description: The filter's part design in hardware_library (category filter).

serial_or_lot.description: Serial or lot of the filter; null when the vendor gives neither.

date.description: ISO date, quoted in YAML (an unquoted 2026-10-19 loads as a date object, not a string).

event.description: One append-only equipment event (docs/equipment_events.md). Never edited or deleted; a correction event fixes a mistake.

event_id.description: Unique within the list, never reused.

at.description: When the hardware changed (not when it was recorded). Required except on corrections.

recorded_at.description: When the event was written down.

from.description: Optional; checked against where the events put it before.

rig.description: The rig, when the host serves more than one.

position.description: Where in the host or rig (a slot, a mount); free text.

void.description: correction: the corrected event did not happen.
